socket_path.description: Path to the Sendmail milter socket.

user.description: Unix user under which mimedefang runs.

group.description: Unix group under which mimedefang runs.

num_workers.description: Number of worker processes to spawn for scanning messages.

max_message_size.description: Maximum message size in bytes (0 = unlimited).

scan_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds allowed for scanning a single message.

temp_dir.description: Directory for temporary files created during scanning.

perl_lib_paths.description: List of directories containing Perl modules used by mimedefang filters.

action_replace_subject_prefix.description: Prefix added to subject line when message is tagged as spam.

action_quarantine_dir.description: Directory where quarantined messages are stored.

action_replace_sender.description: Sender address used for replacement notifications (e.g., spam rejections).

action_replace_recipients.description: Recipient address used for replacement notifications.

action_quarantine_compress.description: Whether to compress quarantined messages with gzip.

log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use (e.g., mail, local0).

log_level.description: Syslog verbosity level (0–7; higher = more verbose).

log_stderr.description: Log messages to standard error (useful for debugging).

filters.description: List of custom filter definitions to load.

whitelist_dir.description: Directory containing whitelisted sender addresses (one per line).

blacklist_dir.description: Directory containing blacklisted sender addresses (one per line).

block_executables.description: Automatically block messages containing executable files.
